consequence.statement: Listed metrics are exposed with the `loki_` prefix instead of `cortex_`, so queries, dashboards or alerts using the old names will not match unless metrics_namespace is set to `cortex`.
consequence.remediation: Set metrics_namespace to `cortex` to keep old names, or update dashboards and alerts.

original.statement: Some Loki metrics' prefix changes from `cortex_` to `loki_` by default (metrics_namespace default `loki`); set `metrics_namespace` to `cortex` to keep the old prefix.

decision.reason: [ev-1f419676f177] says that in this release the listed metrics change from the `cortex_` prefix to `loki_`, and that setting `metrics_namespace` to `cortex` keeps the old names. Nothing in the evidence says anything fails, is rejected or stops being honoured. Loki keeps working and only exposes the metrics under new names, so behavior-change (review) is the right kind. The proposed statement and remediation stay within that, and they match the evidence's own fix of setting `cortex`.
